notes.title: New Controls & Level Select Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are very happy to confirm that an update is now live and available for Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX!
We really appreciate all of the feedback that has gone into this update and, of course, the patience of the community whilst this was worked on.

What's new?

Assisted Controls Menu

If you access the options menu from within the main title screen settings, you will see an option to access a new Assist Menu (Alt key by default on PC). Within this menu, you will find some new optional settings:

 Infinite Lives has now been relocated here.
 Reworked Controls - Turning this option on makes Alex feel more responsive, but removes Alex's sliding effect making some optional areas of the game unreachable when using this mode.
 Adjusted Collisions - Turning this option on reduces Akex's collision with enemies making it slightly less likely for him to die throughout the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016444/6f96af7214d25aea6ff1b956b8367b0a11d2cb0a.png

Level Select

We're very pleased to add this much-requested feature! Once you have finished the game you'll find this option available to use from the main menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016444/f45736f49892c622ed014ab44295ee84828ce6a4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016444/1c0e6fdb4a22056da89cf9c02929522a8198ddaa.png

Additionally, there are a new number of bug fixes and quality of life improvements, including:

 Level Selection Feature (Unlocked after completing the game)
 Assist mode Feature
 Invincibility Balancing and fixes
 Acid waterfall drop rate slowed down
 Cane of flight Fixes
 Animation fixes
 Throwing capsule fix
 Soft Lock Fixes
 Parplin Second Fight fix
 Ladder Fixes
 Localisation fixes
 Gooseka Ball Bug fix
 Jan Ken Pon labels fixed
 Remapping issues fixed
 Level 17 Spikes fix
 Octopus tentacle issue Fixed
 Fire Enemy fix
 Audio fixes
 Alex facing wall fix

As always, thanks for playing - we really appreciate it and hope these updates provide something extra to the Alex Kidd experience for you.

notes.title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX is Available Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016444/8ac67dba7dc72a67da5f58b474920245ac088fcf.gif

After 34 years, Alex Kidd in Miracle World is back in DX form, and we’re excited to welcome old and new fans alike to the Kingdom of Radaxian. What’s more, we’re celebrating this momentous occasion with a 10% launch discount!

Check out the launch trailer!
[previewyoutube=ATFRGHgUNAQ;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333470/Alex_Kidd_in_Miracle_World_DX/

Whilst you're playing stop by the forum and join in interesting discussions including this great discussion about the feel of retro platformers and the way Alex controls: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1333470/discussions/0/3068621701767153478/

We hope you enjoy the game!
